title: How Do You Set Up an Okta and Workday Integration?
summary: Okta Workday integration connects HR events to identity actions in Okta.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Once new hires are flowing, the same four questions come up, and none of them needs a long answer.


### Can I connect Workday and Okta without writing code?


Yes. The Okta side is configured in its admin console, and the gap-filling workflows are built by dragging triggers and actions onto a canvas.


You'll still map fields and write a few conditions, such as "only if worker type is contractor", but that's spreadsheet-formula effort, not programming. Your payoff is that an HR admin can read and fix the flow without opening a ticket with engineering.


### Does Okta already integrate with Workday on its own?


Yes. Okta ships a Workday connection that treats Workday as the source of truth and creates, updates and deactivates Okta accounts from worker records. That covers the core job of turning a hire, change or termination into an identity.


What the connection may not cover is everything around that job: notifying a manager, opening an equipment request, or handling a rehire your way.


Check which of those your tenant's setup already handles before you build anything, because every workflow you skip is one you'll never have to maintain.


### What do I do if the step I need is not listed?


Use a Custom API Call step. Most no-code automation tools offer one: you point it at an endpoint in Workday or Okta's documented API, add your authentication and the request body, and it runs like any other step.


The practical rule is to reach for it only after you've checked the built-in actions, since a prebuilt step handles errors and authentication for you and a custom call leaves both to you.


### Can I self-host the workflow?


It depends on the tool, not on Okta or Workday. Okta's own Workday connection runs inside Okta's cloud, so there's nothing for you to host there.


If your policy requires the automation layer to sit on your own servers, choose a workflow tool that offers a self-hosted edition, and confirm that before you build, because moving workflows between tools later means rebuilding them by hand.
